daily_reference: primary observations plus independent backup only on actual missing primary days; complete calendar year required
time_zone: project UTC daily aggregation from each native timestamp and explicit UTC offset; not provider-certified daily means
native_QC: approved actual observations only; estimated, ice-affected, equipment-malfunction, provisional and other flagged temperatures unavailable in the main record-reference qualification
duplicate_timestamp_rule: collapse exact duplicates; finite conflicting values at the same channel/time unavailable; finite observation retained if also accompanied by an empty duplicate
history: at least three completely observed primary years strictly before target year; never fill history with backups
natural_missingness: every missing primary day in the full calendar year; finite first and last primary days required
independence: distinct publication channel IDs or labels are insufficient alone to establish separate sensor hardware and same water parcel; retain physical-verification status separately, and do not promote record-level eligibility to independently verified natural-gap confirmation without it
uncertainty_unit: site/catchment cohort with shared-record and old-source overlap audit, not individual missing days or multiple channel references
predictive_choice: unchanged original strictly-prior source-only heads/thresholds; supplementary old-only selected air32 CSDI may be reported separately; no configuration selection from these outcomes
free_information: free usable backup observations are directly incorporated operationally; primary-only recovery is a validation exercise, not a paid-query advantage
NEON_access: user has no API token; continue only no-login sources or legitimate public redistribution; official data-endpoint 403 is not zero eligible observations
